failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire... / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: All 7 test failures are caused by SqlServerContainerFixture.InitializeAsync failing with a Docker API error: 'failed to bind host port for 0.0.0.0::172.17.0.3:1433/tcp: address already in use'. This is a Docker port conflict on the shared CI runner, unrelated to the PR's Azure Container Apps Express changes (none of the PR's changed files touch SqlServerContainerFixture or SQL Server tests). Matches known prior cause 'sqlservercontainerfixture-docker-port-conflict' (issue #19743).

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: The E2E test teardown hook fails with 'EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir ...\.e2e-dynamic-debug\first' on Windows. This is a known intermittent Windows file-locking issue in the E2E teardown code, unrelated to the PR's Azure Container Apps Express changes which do not touch the VS Code extension or its E2E test fixtures. Matches known prior cause 'vscode-e2e-windows-teardown-ebusy-rmdir' (issue #20122).
